rule: Game clock: 25 sub-steps per game minute; each hour sets a palette phase (dawn 5, day 6-19, dusk 20, night otherwise, indoors always night). The palette glides from the current phase to the next hour's phase over one game hour (60 steps at 25 ticks). Weather changes glide in 20 steps at 1 tick. A storm egg runs timed sub-events: clouds at once, rain at 20-1019 ms, lightning 0-499 ms after rain, rain 2 minutes past storm end, lightning 2 minutes before it. Lightning flashes 25 or 50 ms, with a 1-in-50 quick re-flash (40-280 ms) and otherwise a 4000-6999 ms pause. Rain ramps 0-4 drops per 100 ms up to a cap and 0-14 down at the end. Weather egg packs kind (low byte) and minutes (high byte); zero minutes means 6000. Ambient bird or cricket bursts repeat with chance 1 in (repeats+1).
keep: Clock-driven palette phase per hour, with the glide starting one hour early and landing on the next phase
Weather as a timed event with a fixed sub-event plan (clouds, rain, lightning with lead times)
Random lightning pause and rare quick re-flash, so flashes do not repeat on a beat
One weather field per zone event with a clearing rule (new kind clears old, except fog)
Ambient repeat rule that decays with each repeat
Hour-based chime count and hour-based sprite frame
change: Counters: overcast and fog counters go negative (clouds kind 6 decrements with no increment; night clamp then destructor decrement). Use one clamped channel per weather type
